    Strictness criteria for literal finite-module factors #

    The primitive deletion in the frozen manuscript has a distinguished projective source P whose covariant representable functor on the factor is faithful and which has no maps to killed modules. This file isolates the exact categorical consequences of those two facts: quotient images of ambient monomorphisms remain monic, and hence all chosen factor right meshes are strict. The dual criterion treats a distinguished injective sink.
